text:
```yaml
name: Remote Access Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  remote-access-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        rust-version: ['1.85.0']

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: ${{ matrix.rust-version }}
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        cargo install cargo-edit
        cargo install clippy
        cargo install rustfmt

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cargo build --all-features
        cargo build --no-default-features
        cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings
        cargo clippy --no-default-features -- -D warnings
        cargo test --all-features
        cargo test --no-default-features
        cargo fmt -- --check

    - name: Check for unnecessary lifetimes
      run: |
        cargo clippy --all-features -- -A clippy::needless_lifetimes
        cargo clippy --no-default-features -- -A clippy::needless_lifetimes

    - name: Update README
      run: |
        sed -i 's/rust-version = "1.83.0"/rust-version = "1.85.0"/' rust/foxglove/README.md
        sed -i 's/edition = "2021"/edition = "2024"/' rust/foxglove/README.md

    - name: Commit and push changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add rust/foxglove/README.md
        git commit -m "chore(rust): bump MSRV to 1.85.0 and edition to 2024"
        git push origin main
```
